title: Elevation, Aeration and Segregation Charges Across the Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements Catalogue
content:
Every trip grain makes through the leg, every cycle of air put through a bin and every lot kept out of the house bin is quoted separately from storage rent. This page posts those charges for all six programmes of Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements.

## The charges posted

**Elevation in** is quoted for each bushel taken into store. **Elevation out** is quoted for each bushel coming out. **Aeration** and **turning** are quoted for each bushel of a cycle, except on the programmes that carry aeration and turning within the agreement, where no separate charge stands. **Segregation** is quoted for each bushel on the programme that keeps a lot out of the house bin.

| Programme | Elevation in (USD per bushel) | Elevation out (USD per bushel) | Aeration (USD per bushel) | Turning (USD per bushel) | Aeration carried by the agreement | Segregation (USD per bushel) | Lot may be commingled |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Open Storage Account | 0.0000 | 0.0400 | 0.0100 | 0.0075 | no | 0.0000 | yes |
| Grain Bank Deposit Account | 0.0150 | 0.0400 | 0.0100 | 0.0075 | no | 0.0000 | yes |
| Commercial Warehouse Receipt Storage | 0.0200 | 0.0400 | 0.0100 | 0.0075 | no | 0.0000 | yes |
| Seasonal Paid-Up Storage Agreement | 0.0200 | 0.0350 | 0.0100 | 0.0075 | no | 0.0000 | yes |
| Conditioned Reserve Storage Agreement | 0.0200 | 0.0400 | 0.0000 | 0.0000 | yes | 0.0000 | yes |
| Identity Preserved Segregated Storage | 0.0300 | 0.0500 | 0.0000 | 0.0000 | yes | 0.0800 | no |

## Notes on the columns

The two programmes that carry aeration and turning within the agreement post nil against both cycle charges; grain on the four programmes that do not carry them is charged 0.0100 for each bushel aerated and 0.0075 for each bushel turned.

Segregation stands at 0.0800 for each bushel on the single programme whose lot may not be commingled with the house bin, and at nil on the five programmes whose grain may be run in with the house.

Elevation in is nil on the Open Storage Account and rises through 0.0150, 0.0200 and 0.0300 as the catalogue rises; elevation out runs between 0.0350 and 0.0500.

## Hypothetical comparison

Five thousand bushels taken in and later taken out under a Grain Bank Deposit Account carry elevation in at 0.0150 for each bushel, which is 75.00, and elevation out at 0.0400 for each bushel, which is 200.00. The same movement on an Identity Preserved Segregated Storage carries 0.0300 in, which is 150.00, 0.0500 out, which is 250.00, and segregation at 0.0800 on the bushels taken in, which is 400.00.
